The weighted port throughput calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the risk-assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.75 across one trial with zero exceptions. Pytest suite 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed successfully in 0.38 seconds using pytest version 8.4.1. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge case handling for zero-weighted ports to ensure the mean remains stable.
